podcast.body: The Everly Brothers decided to record this song, written by Roy Orbison about his new wife. Their version sold half a million copies, significantly boosting Orbison's career and income. "He decided to write a song about his new wife, Claudette, which he pitched to the Evely Brothers when they were honourbed together, on which they decided to record."
